# USMC — United Shared Memory Client

## Reviewed source

- Review date: 2026-10-12
- Source revision reviewed: `bf281f1d68e9e6af44db9d12588a000fac531a61`
- Repository: https://github.com/ellmos-ai/usmc
- Package version declared by this source: `0.3.0`
- Python requirement: `>=3.10`

## What it does

USMC is a Python package and CLI that stores facts, lessons, working notes, and session handoffs in SQLite and can format records as prompt context. `pyproject.toml` declares no direct runtime dependencies. The console command is `usmc` after installation; `python -m usmc` is not an entry point.

## Data path and boundaries

- Default database path: `~/.usmc/usmc_memory.db`.
- `USMC_DB`, the CLI option `--db`, or a Python `db_path` argument can select another path. A custom path is not confined to the home directory.
- USMC does not automatically prune records. The user of the package chooses path, access, backup, and retention.
- The reviewed package modules contain no direct HTTP client. This source observation does not cover Git/pip/build traffic, operating-system networking, or callers and agents that use the network.
- The module manifest value `network: none` describes the reviewed package source; it does not control Git/pip, the host, or callers.
- USMC does not provide an egress firewall or sandbox and does not change process privileges. The process inherits privileges from its launcher.
- `USMC_MEMORY_UNION=1` opts into a shared-schema migration path; consult the guide and tests before using it on an existing database.
- Runtime prose includes German messages; CLI command names and machine-readable tokens are English. There is no multilingual locale framework.

## Install and CLI

```console
python -m pip install "git+https://github.com/ellmos-ai/usmc.git"
usmc --help
usmc status
```

Installing from Git requires network access. For development in a source checkout, use `python -m pip install -e ".[test]"`.

## Related projects

[BACH](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/bach) can use the optional shared-memory schema described in `usmc/memory_union.contract.json`. This is a schema relationship; it does not imply automatic installation or launch.
[ellmos-stack](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/ellmos-stack) composes USMC as its curated-memory component in a self-hosted research stack; its installer fetches USMC from a pinned Git commit.
[GARDENER](https://github.com/ellmos-ai/gardener) provides optional read-only templates for USMC replica snapshots; they are disabled by default and require a separate sync snapshot and caller opt-in.
